description: ML Propagation Loss Model for ns-3 is provided by INESC TEC. The MLPL ns-3 module trains propagation-loss models from experimental-testbed traces. It provides distance-based and position-based variants, example datasets, tests, stable releases and an ns-3 App Store entry. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment. Reuse licence: EUPL-1.2. Predictions depend on the training environment and sampled traces. Generalisation to a different testbed was not established by this review. Potential simulation use: Generate propagation-loss inputs for wireless-network experiments. For catalogue navigation, platform-ns-3 offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
